changelog:
Sort each source's channels the way you want, and find out why a category you switched on is not showing.

WHAT CHANGED

- The sort order you choose when editing a source, alphabetical, provider order or by category, now changes the lists. Before, the choice was saved and never used.
- With several sources sorted differently, the list keeps each source in its own order and takes from them in turn, so one source no longer fills the list before the next begins.
- Scrolling back up a long list shows exactly the rows you scrolled past.
- The More like this row on a title's page follows its source's sort order too.
- More has a new Visibility diagnostics page. For each source and each of Live, Movies and Series, it shows how many categories are on and how many channels are showing. If those do not agree, or channels point at a category that no longer exists, it says so and how to repair it.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Live, Movies and Series stay in the bottom bar. There is no combined All list.

NOT YET

- Episode lists do not yet follow your language filter.
